title: [Chapitre] VII. Analysis situs (troisième mouture) : notes manuscrites (23-26/06/1986).

errors: No outright error. Both statements are left as conjectures, and the author explicitly says he cannot prove them from the current axioms.

His diagnosis looks right. The inclusion omb(L) ⊂ omb(X) ∩ omb(Y) is formal. The reverse inclusion needs an interpolation property: a Λ-element well inside both X and Y must be well inside some element of M lying below both. That does not follow from mere disjointness-style axioms, so an additional axiom (his 'MΛ6') is genuinely needed.
The notation mixes Omb(L) and omb_Λ(L) for a subset L ⊂ M. It must be read as the union of the shadows of the elements of L (as defined at the end of p. 48).

ideas.what: Point-free axiomatization of tame topology via a part order ≤, a 'well-inside' relation ⋘, disjointness ∥, and a basis Λ with 'shadow' maps omb_Λ
ideas.modern_name: Contact / proximity algebras, de Vries algebras, mereotopology (region connection calculus); also abstract stratified or o-minimal frameworks
ideas.usually_credited_to: Whitehead/de Laguna (1920s), Efremovič/Smirnov proximity (1950s), de Vries (1962), Clarke (1981), Düntsch–Vakarelov (2000s); tame topology: van den Dries, Shiota
ideas.where_published: Only programmatic remarks on 'topologie modérée' in Esquisse d'un programme §5 (1984); this axiomatics is unpublished

ideas.what: Localization of disjointness to the shadow of the intersection: X' ∥ Y' iff their traces on Omb(X̃∩Ỹ) are disjoint
ideas.modern_name: Local character of the contact relation; interpolation / Riesz-type axioms in proximity lattices
ideas.usually_credited_to: Interpolation axioms of proximity lattices / de Vries algebras

ideas.what: Shadow map commutes with meets: omb(X) ∩ omb(Y) = omb(X̃∩Ỹ)
ideas.modern_name: Meet-preservation of the way-below / interior operator (continuous lattice / frame-type condition)

missed.claim: The structure Grothendieck manipulates here is essentially a contact/proximity algebra with a basis. The obstruction he hits is exactly the need for an interpolation axiom of the kind built into de Vries algebras and continuous lattices. The parallel between his 'Analysis situs' axiomatics and mereotopology or point-free proximity theory does not seem to be discussed in the literature.
missed.quote: il semble qu'il faut remplacer MΛ5 par une forme plus forte, un peu décourageante hélas!
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It would let historians and logicians situate Grothendieck's unpublished tame-topology axiomatics alongside de Vries duality and region-based topology. It also suggests his missing 'MΛ6' could be borrowed from that well-developed theory.

missed.claim: Two conjectural lemmas were abandoned: localized disjointness, and the shadow of an intersection being the intersection of shadows. Together they would characterize when the 'algebra of strata' behaves like a genuine topological stratification.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is a minor unfinished thread in an unpublished axiomatic program for tame topology. Its interest is mainly historical.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a working page recording a failed attempt to derive two lemmas from an axiom system, ending in abandonment. Its main interest is as a trace of Grothendieck's unpublished order-theoretic tame-topology program and its unnoticed resemblance to proximity/contact algebras. It contains no finished new result.
transcription_corrections: The relation written 'X ≱ Y' (twice) is in fact the crossed-asymp symbol 'X ≭ Y' from p. 48.
Line 'Ce lemme ... la MA4 de la page 41' reads roughly 'Ce lemme est dans la MΛ4 de la page 41'.
'Il faut prouver la MA5 de la page:' reads 'Il faut prouver la MΛ5 de la même page:'.
'plus forte, un peu décourageante[?], hélas!' — 'décourageante hélas!' is confirmed by the image.
In the parenthetical, the relation is '∥_Λ' (Λ subscript), not '∥, ∧'.
